name: 2048 Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as 2048 Ventures (2048.vc; www.2048.vc redirects there), the pre-seed and seed VC firm founded by Alex Iskold, former Managing Director of Techstars NYC (team page). Its own blog announces Fund I ($27M, 2019), Fund II ($67M, 2022) and Fund III ($82,048,000, 2026-01-29); the site links the company LinkedIn page /company/2048vc and X @2048vc. Matches the leads (NYC, Vertical AI, $82M 2026 fund). Not the '2048' puzzle game and not any other '2048'-named fund or company; legal fund-entity names were not confirmed because SEC EDGAR refused the request.

thesis_text.value: First-check, high-conviction lead investor at pre-seed and seed, writing $500K-$3M checks, mainly in NYC and Boston but across the US. Thesis-driven around data moats: vertical AI and systems of record that own workflows and capture proprietary data, deep tech (video, low-cost sensors, drones, robotics, physical AI), healthcare, and biotech infrastructure and novel IP.

Fund close_dates are the dates of the firm's announcement posts (Fund I 2019-05-07, Fund II 2022-01-18, Fund III 2026-01-29), not verified final-close dates.

Application form: https://2048.vc/pitch-us and blog/pre-seed-fast-track.html (the 'Pre-Seed Fast Track' for rounds up to $1.5M, decision within 10 business days) both returned 404 on 2026-10-30; no working pitch form was found.
Nothing found on whether a US entity is required (the firm says it invests across the US; Fund II said US and Canada) or on investing in Indian founders.
portfolio_count_reported (81) is from the 2023 Year-in-Review (Feb 2024); no newer total was found. Fund I backed 50 companies; Fund II planned 60 investments.
Actor Labs: the Eniac Ventures post shows no date; the May 2026 date and founding year 2025 come only from Caplight (database). Caplight lists HQ as Nashville, Tennessee.
Broome AI pre-seed amount was not disclosed. HQ country and founding year not stated for Zeroset, Rely, Pocket, Broome, Nionyx, Kascaid, Nimbus, Aslan or Rondah on the pages read.

Other industrial / robotics / hardware portfolio companies on the Companies page (Atlas motors for drones and robots, Almanac Engineering automated 3D-printing factory, Vela Energy AI for power delivery, Spruce Systems, InfraHub, Ribbit autonomous aviation, Tangram Vision) have no round announcement naming 2048 that was found; their sites (atlasmotion.com, almanacengineering.com, velaenergy.ai) list no round details. Almanac's site lists 2048 Ventures among backers.
Laminar's Series B (Companies page tag) was not found in any announcement; only the July 2025 Series A was recorded.
Psyrin pre-seed ($1M, 2024-10-29, led by 2048 with Concept Ventures and Spacecadet) is just outside the 24-month window and was not recorded as a round.
Aslan Protects post is co-authored by 'Zach Johnston', who is not on the current team page; role not confirmed.
